node.statement: Exact Gram scalarization: for Z in M_n tensor S_{P,Q}, if G=J_{P,Q,n}(Z)^dagger J_{P,Q,n}(Z), then Z^dagger dot Z=G tensor u_Q, ||G tensor u_Q||=||G|| ||u_Q||, and ||G||=||J_{P,Q,n}(Z)||^2. Indeed, entrywise [Z^dagger dot Z]_{ij}=sum_k <Z_{ki},Z_{kj}>u_Q=G_{ij}u_Q by the registered column-Hilbert inner-product display and compressed-product display; the last two equalities are respectively Ruan scalar-tensor invariance and the Hilbert-space Gram identity.
